description: What must be true of the default branch before a commit lands on it. tools/check_branch_protection.py compares this against the live GitHub settings and can apply it. `enforced` records whether the settings have been applied; while it is false the gate still checks that every required_check names a job that actually runs on a pull request, so the list cannot rot before it is switched on.
not_enforced_reason: The repository's working model is a single maintainer pushing checkpoints straight to main from a worktree. Turning on required status checks blocks that push, so it is a deliberate change of working practice and not a settings tweak an agent should make on someone's behalf.
